examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A bucket-like file tree three levels deep, with glyphs and size descriptions. Two folders are seeded in `v-model:expanded`; the chevron and ArrowRight / ArrowLeft fold the rest.

examples.name: Selectable
examples.summary: With `selectable`, activating a node writes its id to `v-model:selected`, marks the row selected and sets `aria-selected`. The bound id is shown under the tree.

examples.name: CustomItem
examples.summary: The `item` slot replaces the label region of every row, here adding a status `Tag`; the `actions` slot adds an end-aligned `IconButton` per row. The chevron, indentation and row states stay owned by the tree.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: While `loading`, the tree renders Skeleton rows in its place and sets `aria-busy` on the root.

examples.name: Empty
examples.summary: With an empty `items` array the tree shows the default `EmptyState`, titled by `emptyTitle` with `emptyDescription`. Pass the `empty` slot to replace it.
